fact: The first official Test match was played in 1877 between Australia and England at the Melbourne Cricket Ground. Australia won by 45 runs.
The Thomas Cup is the premier men's international badminton team championship. India won its first title in 2022 by beating Indonesia 3-0.
The FIFA World Cup was first held in 1930. Uruguay hosted and won the tournament, defeating Argentina 4-2 in the final.
The Grand Slam tournaments are the Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon, and the US Open.
